digest.component_or_area: rebar metrics command and passive instrumentation layer
propositions: Rebar lacks an aggregation layer and durable metric persistence to trend agent-driven dev-loop health over time; the event store records rich history but has no way to query structural trends like gate economics or code-health movement

Three tier-C blindspots leave no trace in the event store: env/integration-diagnosis intervals, bug provenance (which prior change caused a bug), and bug-outcome classification (regression vs plan-defect vs flaky); these require passive instrumentation stamped by trustworthy code
Bug-close UX must not add friction; the required free-text reason must be replaced (not supplemented) by a bounded --class enum persisted on the STATUS event, keeping the required-argument count at 1

Auto-derived caused_by edges from blame run after the bug transitions to closed status, requiring direct _write_link_event bypass to circumvent the closed-source guard; without this, every auto-derived edge is silently dropped
Snapshot store must commit to .rebar/metrics-snapshots.ndjson (git-tracked) not reports/ (gitignored) to prevent silent data loss

A single rebar metrics command must dynamically query date ranges and surface every available metric across three lenses (agent loop health, codebase decay, gate economics) with structured unavailable states for metrics whose signals have not yet accrued
